jobs.title: Resident Services Coordinator/ Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Join our team and make a difference in people’s lives! LifeSTEPS is committed to build thriving communities by empowering individuals and families through supportive housing and services.**

We are seeking a highly motivated **Director of Social Services & Program Coordinator** who will:

* Empower low-income individuals and families to flourish by providing education and resources.
* Ensure our residents, specifically older adults to have an opportunity to thrive in place through housing and services.
* Encourage individuals and families through stable housing and supportive evidence-based services to build resilient communities.
* Maximize the strengths of individuals by providing client assistance, case management, service coordination and conducting community outreach.

**Additional duties will include:**

* Empowering children from low-income and underserved families to flourish by providing After School education and resources.
* Ensure our young individuals a caring and safe place to go to After School to get assistance with homework and academic enrichment.
* Encourage children to thrive and become empowered so they can develop into resilient adults.

**Job Specifics:**

* **Title:** Director of Social Services/Program Coordinator
* **Job classification:** Non-Exempt, DSS 28 hrs per month & PC 10 hrs per week.
* **Job location:** Oakland, CA
* **Pay range:** $21.00- $28.35/hr

**More about us:**

The **STEP** in **LifeSTEPS** stands for **“Skills Training and Educational Programs”** and is the heart of our mission. We believe community development is built “One STEP at a time.” Our vision is that every person served by **LifeSTEPS** will be empowered with the skills, resources, and support to maintain stable housing and break the cycle of poverty. Our founders believe that building affordable housing is only the first step. It is also essential to provide meaningful programs that empower people to move forward in their lives.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in social work, psychology or any related field.
* Two (2) years of experience in a similar environment providing social services to multi-families, senior and children.
* An equivalent combination of education and experience may substitute for the degree
* A background or experience working for a non-profit would be a big plus!
* Valid California Driving License and reliable, insured transportation required

Are you ready to make a difference, stand behind and support people so they achieve their goals and become empowered to move forward in their lives? **Apply today!!!**

**The current vacancy is in the Behavioral Health and Recovery Services Division's East Palo Alto Community Counseling Clinic. The position is located in East Palo Alto but may travel throughout the County to perform duties of the position.**  
  
This position supervises clinicians; provides leadership in developing a peer chart review program; assists in coordinating a Utilization Review Process; assists with outreach to community organizations and partners; stands in for Unit Chief in Department and community meetings; assists Unit Chief in devising and implementing clinic procedures; carries a partial caseload; conducts outreach to the African-American, Latino, Pacific Islander communities; and networks/collaborates with community-based organizations, schools and other partners. jobs.title: Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
Job Description:

**Program Coordinator**

**Senior Division**

**Agency Overview**

Felton Institute responds to the needs of our community by providing innovative, evidence-informed social services that transform lives. Our organization offers 50+ programs that address mental health, the unhoused, early care and education, those impacted by the justice system, transitional age youth, as well as aging adults. Our programs combine the latest scientific research with cultural sensitivity and a deep commitment to supporting and reflecting the communities we serve. Felton offers a dynamic, challenging, and supportive work environment where we encourage the use of professional development, that staff can utilize throughout their career.

**Division Description**

Felton’s Senior Division specializes in a full continuum of mental health services for older adults in outpatient clinics, the community, and supportive housing sites, as well as programs in employment training, economic security, case management, advocacy, and social connection and inclusion.

**Job Description**

Coordinates and monitors project activities including recruitment, in-service training, and other activities in cooperation with the project director and appropriate volunteer station staff. Facilitates placement of Foster Grandparent and Senior Companion volunteers in a variety of community-based child-centered and older adult-centered volunteer sites throughout San Francisco. Provides coordinated pre-service orientation, in-service instruction, and overall supervision of AmeriCorps Seniors volunteers with volunteer station professional staff. Coordinates volunteers’ assignments including assisting volunteer station staff to develop volunteer assignment plans and volunteer activities and monitoring progress toward achieving the expected outcomes and impact specified in assignment plans. Provides information and support to volunteers. Facilitates positive working relationships between volunteers and station staff.

**Specific Responsibilities**

* Manages all aspects placement process for new FGP and SCP volunteers including, recruiting, arranging interviews, performing background checks and other vetting activities in alignment with AmeriCorps federal guidelines.
* Supports all outreach activities including but not limited to: community presentations, staff education and outreach to service providers, public housing clients, and other community members, to increase awareness and recruit new volunteers to the FGP/SCP Program.
* Utilizes social media and electronic communication to raise awareness of the FGP and SCP programs.
* Supports volunteers through verbal, written, and coordinated translation assistance.
* Develops and delivers all required volunteer training including pre- service orientations, in-service training, and annual re-certification of volunteers.
* Collaborates and supports the annual volunteer recognition event, ongoing recognition efforts, and other projects with FSA staff and outside agencies in conjunction with the FGP/SCP Program Staff.
* Helps facilitate the proper completion and timely submission of volunteer monthly timesheets. Coordinates with station supervisors and provides additional training to station staff. Coordinates the data entry of volunteer stipends into monthly spreadsheet, and submission to fiscal for processing.
* Provides administrative support to the program manager, and assists with data collection required for monthly, quarterly, and annual report processing.
* Collaborates with program staff and advisory council in the planning and implementation of the annual volunteer recognition event.
* Other duties as necessary.

**Minimum Requirements and Qualifications**

* A minimum of 2 or more years of experience in a supporting community-based program (experience working with the older adult population is a plus.)
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent educational experience.
* ***Professional working proficiency in Cantonese or Spanish is a plus.***
* Ability to be a team player with a welcoming attitude.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite. The ability to create innovative outreach and marketing materials is a plus.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills with attention to detail.
* Ability to prioritize projects with timely follow-through
* Strong Time management skills
* Strong Interpersonal and communication skills
* Focus on building a strong, thriving, and vibrant volunteer program

**Additional Information:**

Reports to: Program Manager

Job Type: Full Time (30 hours per week)

Work Schedule: Onsite

FLSA Status: Non-Exempt

Salary Range: $34.00 - $37.00 per hour (DOE)

Benefits (subject to election and eligibility): Fully-Paid Medical and Dental Plans; Health Reimbursement Card, Paid Time Off (personal, vacation, and sick time), 403B with company match.

*This position is union-represented by SEIU Local 1021 and is subject to the applicable collective bargaining agreement.*

**Applying Instruction:**

Candidates should apply for the position at our career page “careers.felton.org” OR directly email resumes to “jobs@felton.org”.

**IMP NOTE: Job responsibilities are subject to change according to program requirements.**

jobs.title: Safety & Emergency Preparedness Program Manager
jobs.description:
**Safety & Emergency Preparedness****Progra****m Manager**

  

**The Center for Elders' Independence**is a PACE (Program of All-Inclusive Care for the elderly) organization that uses an interdisciplinary team approach to care planning and care implementation for the purpose of providing high quality, affordable, integrated health care services to the elderly, including an Adult Day Health Center, and promoting autonomy, quality of life and the ability of individuals to live in their communities.

**The Position**: Under the direction of the Chief Human Resources Officer (CHRO), the Safety & Emergency Preparedness, Program Manager is responsible for building, implementing, and continuously improving safety across all PACE care settings for participants, staff, visitors, volunteers and contracted providers. Specifically, this role will oversee initiatives across all CEI facilities including PACE center facilities, clinics, transportation, and home care. This role leads proactive hazard identification, incident response, and safety education, in alignment with OSHA, CMS, state, and local health and safety regulations. The Safety & Emergency Preparedness Program Manager champions a culture of safety, accountability, and continuous improvement throughout the organization to support zero harm and high reliability.

The annual pay range for the Safety & Emergency Preparedness, Program Manager position at Center for Elders' Independence is $102,302 to $153,454. Placement within the range is determined based on job-related factors such as relevant experience, skills, abilities, internal equity, and market data, consistent with CEI's annual compensation review and established compensation practices.

  

**DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Collaborate with the CHRO and other leaders to identify, design, implement, and provide training on a standardized emergency management structure, such as the Hospital Incident Command System (HICS) or a protocol aligned with the National Incident Management System (NIMS), to ensure a coordinated and effective organizational response to emergencies.
* Ensure the effective deployment of emergency information through Everbridge.
* Lead the ongoing development, implementation, evaluation, and continuous improvement of CEI's comprehensive Safety Program.
* Conduct regular Environment of Care (EOC) rounds, and other preparedness activities, across all PACE locations—clinical and non-clinical—to proactively identify and mitigate safety risks.
* Chair the Safety Committee and actively participate in other internal committees, contributing to ongoing audit preparedness (e.g., CMS, DHCS).
* Assess potential hazards to participants and staff and develop corrective action plans to address and prevent incidents.
* Establish and enforce safety policies and procedures that ensure full compliance with OSHA, CMS, DHCS, CDPH, and other relevant regulatory bodies.
* Investigate safety incidents, prepare detailed reports with findings and lead root cause analyses and corrective action planning.
* Use technology tools including incident reporting platform, audit checklists, CAP tracker, dashboard/BI tools, LMS training platforms, and document control software.
* Design and deliver engaging safety training programs for staff, covering topics such as infection control, hazard communication, emergency response, and incident command.
* Collaborate cross-functionally with departments to uphold safety standards across all care environments, including facilities, transportation, and home care.
* Direct the Emergency Preparedness Program, ensuring organizational readiness for a range of emergency scenarios.
* Maintain accurate documentation of safety audits, incident investigations, and regulatory inspections.

  

**REQUIRED** **QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Bachelor's degree in Health & Safety, Public Health, Healthcare Administration, or related field.
* Minimum of three years' experience in healthcare safety, emergency management, or risk management.
* In-depth knowledge of OSHA, CMS, and state safety regulations, particularly in elder care or outpatient settings.
* Strong oral and written communication, training, and problem-solving skills.
* Familiarity with risk management principles and incident command systems.

  

**PREFERED QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Experience in a PACE organization, long-term care, or home health environment.
* Certified Healthcare Safety Professional (CHSP).
* OSHA 30-Hour – General Industry certification.

  

The above job description is intended to communicate the general function of the above-mentioned position and by no means shall be considered an exhaustive or complete outline of the specific tasks and functions that will be required. CEI reserves the right to change job descriptions, site assignments, and or work hours as required by the needs of the program. All employees are expected to perform their duties within their ability as required by the job and/or as requested by management.

Description:

**Location:** San Jose Yard

**Reports To:** Operations Manager

**Department:** Operations

**Schedule:** Varies by market; may include overnight, weekend, and holiday coverage

**Pay Rate:** $71,000 – $80,000 annually

**FLSA Status:** Exempt

**About Booster**

Booster is building the frictionless, tech-powered energy supply chain for modern transportation. We power the world's largest fleets more efficiently and sustainably through our direct operations and world-class partners.

Our BoosterOS platform eliminates the usual manual frictions between order and cash, thereby enabling energy delivery to support more businesses at lower costs. Today, we deliver conventional and renewable fuels directly to fleet vehicles nationwide, reducing costs and lowering carbon emissions—while paving the way for future clean alternatives.

As demand for sustainable energy outpaces infrastructure, Booster provides the critical tech-driven, modular solution, helping customers seamlessly transition to better solutions for their operations, their communities, and our planet.

We lead by our values and hold ourselves – and each other — accountable to them. Our values guide how we interact, the choices we make, and the decisions we take—ultimately driving our long-term success as a business.

* **Safety** as our daily guiding principle,
* **Customer** at the heart of all our actions,
* **Integrity** in doing the right thing even when no one is looking,
* **Excellence** in never settling and always raising the bar
* **Boldness** in being brave and creating the future, and
* **Stewardship** in supporting the planet and everyone on it—we support our communities, our customers, and our people while driving play, purpose, and potential every day.

The **Operations Supervisor** is responsible for the safe, reliable, and efficient execution of daily yard and field operations within an assigned market.

This role directly leads Service Professionals and ensures each shift is executed in accordance with customer commitments, safety requirements, fleet readiness, labor plans, and Booster’s operating standards.

The Operations Supervisor is a frontline leader who manages the business through **Booster’s Business System (BBS)** and the core pillars of **SQDPP — Safety, Quality, Delivery, Productivity, and People**. The Supervisor is expected to use visual management, standard work, structured problem solving, and disciplined follow-through to identify performance gaps and take corrective action.

Success in this role means the shift operates safely, customer commitments are consistently met, labor and fleet are effectively utilized, drivers are developed and held accountable, and recurring operational issues are systematically reduced.

* Ensure customer commitments are completed accurately and on time.
* Maintain clear operational handoffs between shifts.
* Monitor route completion, service misses, delays, and operational exceptions.
* Take timely containment action when performance is at risk.
* Escalate material customer, safety, fleet, or operational issues when appropriate.

**2. Safety, Quality & Compliance — 20%**

* Serve as the frontline owner of safety and compliance for the assigned shift.
* Reinforce Booster safety standards and stop unsafe work when necessary.
* Ensure Service Professionals complete required pre-trip and post-trip inspections.
* Maintain compliance with DOT, hazmat, environmental, and company requirements.
* Conduct field observations, audits, and coaching related to safe work practices.
* Monitor service quality and identify execution gaps that may create customer, safety, or compliance risk.
* Ensure incidents, injuries, spills, vehicle issues, and near misses are immediately reported and appropriately escalated.
* Participate in incident investigations, RCCMs, and corrective actions.

**Company Description**

"We're not in the shipping business; we're in the information business" - Peter Rose, Expeditors Founder

We take care of our employees, and they take care of our customers!

Become a member of a global community! The international logistics industry is an integral piece of the global trade puzzle; we make the world go round. Global supply chain management is what we do, and at the heart of Expeditors you will find professionalism, leadership, and a friendly environment, all of which foster an innovative, customer service-based approach in logistics. Expeditors is a global logistics company headquartered in Seattle, Washington. As a Fortun 500 company, we employ over 19,000 trained professionals in a worldwide network of over 350+ locations across six continents. Expeditors satisfies the increasingly sophisticated needs of international trade through customized solutions and seamless, integrated information systems.

Our Mission:

We recruit, train, and retain the very best logistics and technical experts in the world over. **We love to promote from within** - more than 50 percent of our employees have been at Expeditors for five years or more. Our high retention rate is influenced by a unique compensation program for positions that are more than just jobs - they're chances to grow, do what you love and build a career with us!

www.expeditors.com

 **Job Description**

The Operations Manager is responsible for orchestrating end-to-end Order Management and  
logistics supporting Order Management demands. Serving as the primary escalation point and  
interface between NASA technical leads, program stakeholders, and cross-functional  
operations, supply chain teams, and partner engagement teams. This role applies deep  
logistics and systems deployment expertise to deliver mission-critical compute, network, and  
data center infrastructure on schedule, while maintaining strict adherence to NASA operational  
standards.  
Responsibilities  

* Oversee the end-to-end order lifecycle from requisition intake and validation to

fulfillment, staging, and site deployment across NASA centers and partner facilities in  
support of the customer’s journey  

* Serve as the primary escalation point for NASA program managers, engineering teams,

and vendor networks regarding complex order inquiries, delays, and critical supply  
bottlenecks.  

* Direct, mentor, and balance the day-to-day workload of the Operations Coordinator

team, handling tiered operational questions and ensuring quality across high-volume  
order pipelines.  

* Audit and analyze order fulfillment cycles, vendor lead times, and capacity forecasts to

identify operational bottlenecks and implement process improvements.  

* Review, refine, and present infrastructure demand forecasts, SLA compliance

dashboards, and order status reports to senior NASA leadership and other stakeholders  

* Lead weekly customer operational syncs, pipeline reviews, and cross-functional

alignment sessions with site operations, logistics teams, and other various stakeholders  

* Develop, document, and maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for order

triage, change management, and asset tracking.  

* Execute structured training and onboarding plans to scale coordinator capabilities and

ensure compliance with federal asset tracking standards.  

* Assume operational leadership and decision-making authority during critical deployment

windows or when senior operations management is unavailable.  

* Foster a high-reliability team culture centered on operational precision, customer

partnership, and proactive risk mitigation

 **Qualifications**

Qualifications  

* Bachelor’s degree in supply chain management, Logistics, Operations Research,

Information Systems, or equivalent professional experience.  

* 4+ years of hands-on experience in Order Management, logistics, or technical fulfillment,

preferably supporting technical infrastructure, data centers, or mission-critical tech  
deployments  

* Proven track record leading or mentoring operational teams in fast-paced, high-volume

environments with a collaborative leadership style, a positive can-do mindset and a passion for operational excellence  

* Strong familiarity with technical infrastructure components (servers, networking

equipment, optical hardware, cabling, power/cooling assets) or managing specialized logistics operations

* Demonstrated expertise in order management platforms (e.g., SAP), and

spreadsheet-based reporting (advanced Excel / Google Sheets).  

* Exceptional analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret fulfillment

data and drive actionable operational decisions  

* Superior customer-facing and executive communication skills, with experience managing

escalations under tight deadlines with proven stakeholder management

* Willingness to Travel: 20%
* Must be legally authorized to work in the United States

 **Additional Information**

**Expeditors offers excellent benefits:**

* Paid Vacation, Holiday, Sick Time
* Health Plan: Medical, Prescription Dug, Dental and Vision
* Life and Long-Term Disability Insurance
* 401(k) Retirement Savings Plan (US only)

jobs.title: Business Operations Manager
jobs.description:
**About Campfire**
------------------

Campfire is building modern accounting software for startups and mid-size tech companies, and we're going head to head with giants like NetSuite to do it. Our AI-native general ledger runs the close, revenue recognition, and reporting for finance teams that have outgrown QuickBooks and refuse to settle for a legacy ERP.

**The role**
------------

You'll own the business behind the business. You'll be the person leadership sends in on Campfire's highest-stakes problems, including ones nobody here has solved before. You'll get problems, not tasks, and you'll be expected to take them from "this is a mess" to "this runs itself." You'll work directly with every team at Campfire, and you'll have the authority to make decisions.

**What you'll own**
-------------------

* **The operating rhythm.** Help build and run the planning, goal-setting, and metrics cadence the company runs on. Make sure every team knows the number they own and whether they're hitting it.
* **The numbers leadership trusts.** Set the definitions for every core metric, then own the reporting for ARR, pipeline, bookings, retention, and spend. When the founders or the board ask a question, you have the answer, pulled straight from the raw data yourself.
* **Commercial contracts and vendors.** Run vendor negotiations and renewals, manage the contract lifecycle with legal, and make sure we never auto-renew something we don't need.
* **Sales and GTM operations.** Own CRM configuration, territory and quota planning, and the mechanics of how reps get paid. Make the sales team faster without letting the data get messy.
* **The company's infrastructure.** Insurance, office and real estate, compliance, and the systems that keep a growing company running. Nothing falls through the cracks on your watch.
* **Special projects that matter.** New market launches, partnerships, monetization and packaging work alongside our pricing lead, board prep. You'll take new initiatives from zero to one. When something important doesn't have an owner yet, it lands with you.
* **Automation over headcount.** If a process runs on spreadsheets and goodwill, rebuild it with code, AI, and the right tools so it scales without adding people.

**Who you are**
---------------

We care more about trajectory than pedigree. If you've owned hard problems end to end and have the results to show for it, we want to hear from you.

* **An owner, not a coordinator.** 2-4 years in business operations, top-tier consulting, banking, VC or PE, or founding a startup. You've been the person things roll up to.
* **Analytical to the core.** You're excellent in spreadsheets and you build models that hold up to scrutiny - you can tell the story behind the numbers.
* **AI-native in how you work.** You already use tools like Claude Code to automate work, build internal tools, and get more done than a team twice your size.
* **Commercially sharp.** You can read a contract, spot the bad clause, and negotiate a better deal with a vendor.
* **A clear communicator.** You can walk leadership or the board through a messy problem and leave them with a decision, and you're just as effective working alongside an AE or a support rep.
* **Relentless follow-through.** You close loops. When you say something will get done, it gets done, and people stop checking.
* **Comfortable with ambiguity.** Half of this job doesn't exist yet. You'll define it.

**Why this role**
-----------------

* **Direct line to leadership.** You work with leadership on decisions that move the business.
* **Breadth you won't find elsewhere.** Finance, sales, legal, and operations all cross your desk. It's a launchpad into leadership and the fastest path to running a business yourself.

Compensation Range: $150K - $200K

jobs.title: Revenue Operations Process Manager
jobs.description:
**Who we're looking for**

We're looking for a Revenue Operations Process Manager to shape how our go-to-market engine actually works.

In this role, you'll own the business processes, governance, and operating framework that powers our upper-funnel revenue engine. processes within our ABM tool 6sense. Your focus isn't on configuring the system; it's on defining how work should flow across Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success, so everything operates as one cohesive system. You will define how target accounts are identified, prioritized, routed, engaged, and progressed through the buyer journey using 6sense as a core component of our operating model.

You'll act as the bridge between business and technical teams, translating GTM strategy into clear, scalable process logic and requirements.

This is a process architecture role, not a systems administration role. Success isn't measured by tickets closed or configurations shipped; it is measured by clarity, scalability, adoption, and performance.

Your focus is not system administration or campaign execution. Instead, you'll design the business logic, workflows, decision frameworks, and governance that ensure our account-based strategy translates into consistent execution.

**What You Will Own**

**Design End to End GTM processes**

* Build and evolve workflows across Marketing, SDR, Sales, and Customer Success
* Ensure inbound, outbound, and account-based motions work together as a unified system
* Define lifecycle stages, ownership models, and clean handoffs across teams
* Design how target accounts move from identification through engagement, opportunity creation, and pipeline progression
* Establish account stages, buying stages, ownership models, and engagement plays
* Ensure inbound, outbound, and ABM motions operate as a coordinated system rather than independent workflows

**Translate Strategy into Execution**

* Translate GTM strategy into:
  + Process flows
  + Decision logic
  + Business requirements
  + Acceptance criteria
* Partner closely with CRM and Systems teams, acting as the primary interface with GTM stakeholders
* Ensure implementations reflect business intent (not just technical feasibility)

**Own Process Governance & Data Clarity**

* Define and enforce:
  + Source-of-truth definitions
  + Data ownership models
  + Process standards across systems
* Create clear, human-readable documentation so teams understand how things work

**Define routing, prioritization, and signals**

* Design lead, account, and opportunity routing strategies
* Build prioritization frameworks based on segmentation and signals
* Eliminate gaps, duplication, and conflicting engagement paths

**Drive Performance & Continuous Improvement**

* Define SLAs, KPIs, thresholds, and success criteria across GTM motions
* Design and deliver high quality process training to drive GTM team members to optimize day to day activities
* Monitor process health (e.g., coverage, routing accuracy, adoption)
* Continuously iterate as GTM strategy, segments, and tooling evolve

**What Success Looks Like**

* GTM processes are clearly defined, consistently executed, and widely adopted
* Stakeholders understand how the system works without relying on tribal knowledge
* Salesforce reflects intentional design, not incremental patchwork
* Process changes are scalable, testable, and measurable
* Business and systems teams operate with shared clarity and alignment

**What This Role Is Not**

* Not a Salesforce Administrator — does not own configuration or system builds
* Not a Marketo / campaign execution role
* Not a reporting or analytics-only function
* Not a ticket-based support role for CRM requests

**What** **We're** **Looking For**

* 5+ years in Revenue Operations, GTM Operations, or Sales/Marketing Operations
* High learning agility and analytical thinking
* Proven ownership of lead management, routing, or demand processes in complex GTM environments
* Experience working across Sales, Marketing, SDR, and Systems teams
* Exposure to ABM tools like 6sense
* Exposure to different revenue intelligence tools, such as Marketo, Groove, Dialpad and Gong
* Proven experience operating in a scaled B2B organization (SaaS or complex GTM preferred)
* Process-first thinker — designs for clarity, scalability, and real-world usability
* Exceptional written communicator — translates complexity into clear logic and specs
* Systems translator — bridges business needs and technical implementation seamlessly
* Structured problem solver — brings order to ambiguity and incomplete inputs
* Influencer without authority — earns trust across senior GTM and technical stakeholders
* Detail-oriented but outcome-driven — balances precision with business impact

**Compensation:**

The estimated pay ranges for this role are as follows: **$97,000 - $130,000**

The salary range represents the low and high end of the salary range for this job in the US. Minimums and maximums may vary based on location. The actual salary offer will carefully consider a wide range of factors such as your skills, qualifications and experience. In addition to the salary you may be eligible for a corporate bonus which can range **up to 30%.**

jobs.title: SOCIAL SERVICES CARE COORDINATOR-BILINGUAL
jobs.description:
**ORGANIZATION**

The mission of Ravenswood Family Health Network (RFHN) is to improve the health of the community by providing culturally sensitive, integrated primary and preventative health care to all, regardless of ability to pay or immigration status, and collaborating with community partners to address the social determinants of health.

**POSITION SUMMARY**

The Social Services Care Coordinator provides care coordination to patients served through the Medication-Assisted Treatment (MAT) and Health Care for the Homeless (HCH) programs and ECM programs. Under the direction of the Department Manager of Social Services, and in collaboration with the Senior Manager of Social Services and HCH Program Manager, the Coordinator supports patients experiencing homelessness, housing instability, alcohol dependence, and complex medical and social needs.

The Coordinator manages an active caseload of approximately 35 patients, completing assessments, developing care plans, coordinating services, conducting outreach, and connecting patients to healthcare, housing, benefits, and other community resources. The Coordinator works closely with the MAT and HCH teams to address barriers to care and social determinants of health while promoting patient engagement, self-advocacy, and independence.

The position utilizes trauma-informed, culturally responsive, patient-centered, motivational interviewing, and harm-reduction approaches and collaborates with internal teams and community partners to support coordinated care and improved patient outcomes.

**DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

*To be performed in accordance with RFHN Policies and Procedures*

* Serves as the primary contact to assigned social services members and advocates to help them navigate the healthcare system.
* Maintains an active caseload of approximately 35+ patients, providing ongoing social services care coordination based on patient needs, acuity, and program requirements.
* Completes comprehensive social service, psychosocial, and social determinants of health assessments to identify patient needs, strengths, barriers, risks, and available support systems.
* Develops individualized care plans in collaboration with patients, the MAT treatment team, Health Care for the Homeless (HCH) Program Manager, Senior Manager of Social Services, medical providers, behavioral health staff, and other members of the care team.
* Provides care coordination to patients participating in the Medication-Assisted Treatment (MAT) program with a focus on alcohol dependence, supporting engagement in treatment and continuity of care.
* Identifies ECM eligible candidates and refers them to Program Associate and covers for ECM cases as needed.
* Works collaboratively with the Health Care for the Homeless program to address the unique healthcare and social service needs of patients experiencing homelessness or housing instability.
* Provides patient outreach and engagement in clinic and community settings, including shelters, housing programs, and other locations where patients may be accessing services.
* Educates patients about housing resources, eligibility requirements, housing navigation processes, and available supportive housing and homeless services.
* Connects patients to appropriate housing resources, emergency shelter, transitional housing, permanent supportive housing, coordinated entry, and other community-based services.
* Identifies and coordinates referrals addressing social determinants of health, including housing, food insecurity, transportation, income, benefits, employment, legal services, behavioral health, alcohol dependence treatment, and other identified needs.
* Assists patients with accessing public benefits and supportive services, including SSI/SSDI, CalFresh, cash assistance, health insurance, and other available benefits.
* Assists patients with obtaining documents necessary to access housing, benefits, healthcare, and other services, including identification, birth certificates, financial documentation, and other required records.
* Supports patients with scheduling appointments, appointment reminders, transportation coordination, referrals, and other activities designed to reduce barriers to healthcare and treatment.
* Coordinates referrals and follows up with patients and service providers to promote successful connection to recommended services.
* Provides support during transitions of care, including hospital discharge, emergency department visits, residential treatment, alcohol dependence treatment, and transitions between healthcare and community-based services.
* Uses trauma-informed, culturally responsive, patient-centered, motivational interviewing, and harm-reduction approaches when working with patients.
* Educates and supports patients in developing self-advocacy, self-management, and independent skills to navigate healthcare, housing, and social service systems.
* Advocates for patients and assists in resolving barriers to healthcare, treatment, housing, benefits, and other needed services.
* Maintains regular communication with patients and, when authorized, family members, caregivers, guardians, or other identified support persons.
* Participates in interdisciplinary case conferences and collaborates with the Manager of Social Services, Senior Manager of Social Services, HCH Program Manager, MAT treatment team, medical providers, behavioral health staff, and community partners to coordinate patient care.
* Maintains timely, accurate, and complete documentation of assessments, care plans, patient contacts, referrals, interventions, and outcomes in Epic and other required systems.
* Maintains documentation and data necessary to meet RFHN, program, county, state, federal, health plan, and funding requirements.
* Identifies urgent or high-risk patient needs and promptly communicates concerns to the Manager of Social Services, Senior Manager of Social Services, HCH Program Manager, and/or appropriate clinical team member

jobs.title: Senior Training & Quality Assurance Strategist
jobs.description:
Scribd, Inc. is on a mission to advance human understanding. Our four products — Scribd, Slideshare, Everand, and Fable — help billions of people across the globe move beyond access and into insight, application, and expertise.

**Culture at Scribd, Inc.**
---------------------------

We support a culture where our employees can be real and be bold; where we debate and commit as we embrace plot twists; and where every employee is empowered to take action as we prioritize the customer.

We believe the best work happens when individual flexibility is balanced with meaningful community connection. Scribd Flex empowers employees to choose the workstyle and location that support their best performance, while committing to intentional in-person moments that strengthen collaboration and culture. Occasional in-person attendance is required for all Scribd, Inc. employees, regardless of location.

So what are we looking for in new team members? At Scribd, Inc., we hire for “GRIT.” Traditionally defined as the intersection of passion and perseverance toward long-term goals, GRIT reflects the mindset we expect from every employee. For us, it also serves as a practical framework for how we work: setting and achieving Goals, delivering Results within your role, contributing Innovative ideas and solutions, and strengthening the broader Team through collaboration and attitude.

This posting reflects an approved, open position within the organization.

**About The Team and Role:**
----------------------------

Customer Operations is the backbone of trust and reliability for readers, listeners, and creators across our products. Our team makes sure every support interaction, whether with a paying subscriber or a creator publishing on our platform, is handled with quality, consistency, and care. We also help keep the platform and its community safe, including handling sensitive content and legal or policy-related requests.

As Senior Training & Quality Assurance Strategist, you’ll build the training and quality program that helps every customer get consistently great support, whether from our internal teams or our outsourced partners. You’ll design the curriculum, quality rubrics, and calibration process that turn quality from something we measure after the fact into something we build in from the start. This is a foundational role: you’ll shape what great support looks like across Customer Operations and build a program that can scale with us. You’ll also use what quality and training reveal to influence how we work, helping teams find better, smarter ways to get things done. You’ll lead through influence, partnering closely with the leaders who manage the people doing the work.

--------------

You’re a builder who can connect the pieces we have today into one structured, proactive program, and you know the difference between a training program that looks good on paper and one that actually changes performance. You take initiative without waiting for direction and stay comfortable with ambiguity, including in a remote environment. You can get buy-in and drive real change across teams you don’t manage, through credibility and relationships, not a reporting line. That means carrying yourself with confidence in front of leaders, challenging a decision respectfully, and bringing people along. You think in systems: you don’t just fix the immediate error, you look for what let it happen in the first place.

* Work with our Trust & Compliance teams so training and workflows reflect compliance requirements and sensitive cases are handled consistently
* Own an ongoing, company-wide customer advocacy training program, a “day in the life” of Customer Operations, so everyone understands our customers’ experiences

**What You Have:**

### **Minimum qualifications:**

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* 5 years of experience managing cross-functional or cross-team projects.

**About the job**
-----------------

A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Program Manager at Google, you’ll lead complex, multi-disciplinary projects from start to finish — working with stakeholders to plan requirements, manage project schedules, identify risks, and communicate clearly with cross-functional partners across the company. Your projects will often span offices, time zones, and hemispheres. It's your job to coordinate the players and keep them up to date on progress and deadlines.

As a Supply Chain Program Manager, you are responsible for ensuring supply chain readiness for multiple programs with specific attention to: program schedule, cost optimization, multi-sourcing and material readiness and availability for new product prototype builds and mass production ramp-ups. You will have direct experience in a manufacturing environment. jobs.title: Case Manager
jobs.description:
With traumatic brain injury, life changes in an instant. For us, there is no greater reward than easing human suffering and helping people put their lives back together. As a Case Manager, you will play a critical role in transforming lives and helping individuals regain their independence and quality of life.

At CNS, we are a community of "PATHfinders" who work together to find every path possible for our patients to reach their maximum independence and quality of life. We create a supportive work environment through selflessness, innovation, and hard work. We take work very seriously, but we also enjoy a great atmosphere of fun and professional development, and we are committed to promoting a rich environment for each other to thrive through collaboration and empowerment.

Pay Range: $80,000 - $95,000

**Responsibilities**

The Clinical Case Manager is concerned with and, under the supervision of the Director of Rehabilitation, responsible for the development, implementation and management of all clinical aspects of Centre for Neuro Skills. They are an integral part of the overall decision making process bridging both clinical and administrative matters involving both the clinic and residential sites. The six core components of clinical case management include: processes and relationships, health care management, community resources and support, service delivery, psychosocial intervention; and rehabilitation case management. Work is full time during the weekdays Monday- Friday from 7:30am-4:30pm and requires some on-call and overtime work.Your key responsibilities will include:

* Collects information about the patient’s situation and functioning to identify individual needs, and assessment of that information to develop a comprehensive case management plan.
* Plans the specific objectives, goals and actions designed to meet the patient’s needs. This plan should be action-oriented and time- specific. Establishes, communicates, and facilitates initial program issues and goals with appropriate designated staff.
* Communicates with external stakeholders and families to ensure coordination of services.
* Implements the specific case management activities and/or interventions that will lead to accomplishing the plan goals.
* Evaluates, at appropriate intervals, the plan’s effectiveness in reaching the desired outcomes and goals. This process might lead to a modification or change in the case management plan in its entirety or any of its components.

**Qualifications**

Successful candidates will have:

* **Passion for Care**: A deep understanding of the requirements for providing the type of care and supervision needed, including the ability to communicate effectively with them.
* **Leadership Skills**: The ability to recruit, employ, train, and evaluate qualified staff, and to make tough decisions when necessary.

**Experience and Education**

* **Educational Background**: Bachelor’s degree in a related field required. Master’s or licensure/credential preferred but experience can be used to offset this level of education/licensing.
* **Work Experience**: Minimum of 3-5 years’ experience in rehabilitation or related field.
* **Specialized Knowledge**: CCM preferred. Successful completion of CCM required upon meeting eligibility guidelines. Demonstrate a capacity for and interest to absorb a global knowledge of medical and clinical rehabilitation aspects relating to traumatic brain injury. Experience in which supervisory abilities have been demonstrated.

jobs.description:
**About Abode:**

When you join Abode, you’re not just taking a job, you’re becoming part of a team creating meaningful change in our communities and a commitment to lasting housing stability.

At Abode, we believe everyone deserves a safe and stable place to call home. Our mission is to solve homelessness through housing and supportive services that help individuals and families achieve stability and independence. Grounded in the Housing First model, we meet people where they are and provide individualized support based on their needs, goals, and strengths.

**Housing Ends Homelessness**

**Our Mission:**

Abode works to end homelessness by assisting low-income, unhoused people, including those with special needs, to secure stable, supportive housing; and to be advocates for the removal of the causes of homelessness.

**Our Values:**

* Start with Dignity
* Take Smart Risks
* Be transparent
* Solve for today and tomorrow
* Spark each other’s strengths

**About The Role**:

The Program Manager will provide leadership, support, and oversight to a multidisciplinary team to assist adults and their families who are homeless and/or formerly homeless. This team will engage, and support participants maintaining housing /shelter placement, develop and execute housing stability plans and provide wraparound supportive services. Key responsibilities include supervision of staff and oversight of services delivery, close coordination with case management partners and budget and oversight of public contracts.

**How You Make An Impact**:

* Provide direct supervision to all Program staff and interns.
* Provide regular and appropriate feedback including training, opportunities for professional growth, verbal, and written improvement plans when needed, and regular evaluations.
* Ensure that all program staff under your leadership are meeting the goals as set forth in their program’s respective grants.
* Coordinate training, schedules, caseloads, vacations, and assignments as part of program administration.
* Provide support to staff when dealing with client crises, problem solving with managers on challenging participant situations, and develop on-going housing stability interventions with staff.
* Build collaborative relationships with property management and on-site resident services staff if applicable. Advocate for participants housed at various sites as needed.
* Supervise staff and provide feedback, coaching, training, and disciplinary action as needed.
* Work with staff to ensure timely and accurate data entry is occurring.
* Work with Data Specialists on reporting to funders and stakeholders on program activities.
* Monitor Programs contracts to ensure maximization of funding and program deliverables are met and support with program audits.
* Assist in developing policy and procedures and other aspects of programs.
* Facilitate case conferencing and administrative meetings.
* Assist in developing materials, assessment tools, job descriptions, and other program processes/documents/tools.
* Other duties as assigned.

**How You Meet Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in psychology, Human Services, Social Work, Sociology, or related field or equivalent experience.
* 3 years of professional experience in the human services, social work, or related field and demonstrated experience working collaboratively with low-income families and providing service coordination.
* 2 years of direct experience in the provision and supervision of case management services to individuals who are homeless and/or have extremely low incomes.
* Use of personal vehicle and proof of a valid and current California Driver’s License and current insurance along with a clean DMV record required.

**Our Benefits and Perks:**

* **Competitive pay:** $75,000 - $92,000 annually
* **Work arrangement**: Onsite position; may be eligible for hybrid or remote work, subject to supervisor approval and factors including job responsibilities, remote location, and employee suitability.
* **PTO:**19 days per year, increasing with tenure
* **Holidays:** 12 paid holidays per year
* **Health & Wellness:**
  + 100% medical, dental and vision coverage options for employees
  + Employer subsidized options for dependent health care."

  + Mental health care service provided by Teledoc
  + Flexible Spending Account (FSA)
    - Commuter

  + **Retirement Plan:** 403(b) w/ employer match & contribution programs

**Notice**: Abode Services is an Equal Opportunity Employer and Drug Free Workplace.

Required

**BENEFITS CASE MANAGER**

**The Center for Elders' Independence (CEI)** provides a Program of All-Inclusive Care for the Elderly (P.A.C.E.) - a comprehensive healthcare model specifically designed for low-income, frail seniors. It combines medical and social services along with vigilant care planning and coordination in order to keep frail seniors safely living at home and in their communities. This unique and highly effective model utilizes an interdisciplinary team approach to care planning to drive high quality, affordable, integrated healthcare services to the elderly.

**Position****:** Under the supervision of Director of Enrollment and Member Services, the Benefits Case Manager ensures that all CEI participants are enrolled in all income and insurance benefits that they are eligible for. Benefits Case Manager will be required to work effectively with participants, participant families, representative payees and relevant government agencies to proactively maintain and address benefit eligibility issues that arise as well as support different prospect/participant benefit related projects within the agency.

The hourly pay range for the Benefits Case Manager position at Center for Elders' Independence is $26.25 to $39.38. Placement within the range is determined based on job-related factors such as relevant experience, skills, abilities, internal equity, and market data, consistent with CEI's annual compensation review and established compensation practices.

  

**Essential Job Functions:**

**Department and Caseload Management**

* Benefits Case Manager keeps track and ensures that all participants' benefits eligibility needs are met; this includes working directly with the participants, participant families, representative payees and the relevant government agencies to proactively maintain benefit eligibility and resolve all eligibility issues that arise.
* Manages the assigned participant eligibility caseload which includes attending enrollment, care conference meetings and conducting home visits with participants where eligibility issues need to be addressed.
* Manages the caseload information on participants in a well-organized and secure filing system as devised by the department.
* Keeps track and monitors the eligibility status of the participant assigned to the caseload and generates regular reports as needed.

  

**Income Benefits**

* Ensures that the CEI participants' income information assigned to the caseload is known and verified at all times and is well documented in the CEI database.
* Ensures that accurate share-of-cost information is gathered, well documented and communicated with the participant on the caseload and the finance staff in an effective and in a timely fashion to enable CEI to collect share-of-cost revenue.
* Works with the participants, families and social workers connected to the assigned caseload to ensure that the Board and Care and SNF income level changes are made by the social security administration, that all involved understand the changes and that the benefit levels are accurate on all Board and Care documents.
* Communicates income issues to social work, finance, member services and other pertinent staff as needed affiliated with the participant on the caseload to ensure interdepartmental effectiveness.

  

**Insurance Benefits**

* Ensures that all CEI participants' benefit information on the assigned caseload is known and verified at all times and well documented in the CEI database.
* Ensures that CEI participants who are assigned to the caseload are fully enrolled in Medi-Cal and any Medicare benefits they are eligible for prior to enrollment and following enrollment (ie assist with getting participants who are Medi-Cal only qualify for Medicare and participant missing Medicare Part A qualified for QMB benefit to obtain Part A coverage).

jobs.title: Global Account Manager
jobs.description:
Outset invented a better way to do research: AI-powered user interviews.

Global brands like Hubspot, Microsoft, Uber and Nestle use Outset to achieve deeper, qualitative insights about their users at unprecedented speed and scale.

The research industry is massive (>$140B and growing) and ripe for disruption. Incumbents are outdated, slow, and burdened by high-cost services. That's our opportunity.

Outset is backed by top Silicon Valley investors and raised a $30M Series B in December 2025—less than six months after our Series A—led by Radical Ventures with participation from M12 (Microsoft’s venture arm), 8VC, Y Combinator, and Adverb Ventures.

The raise follows a breakout year, with our business growing 8x as enterprise customers across industries adopt our category, AI‑moderated research, as the new standard for understanding people.

We’re a tight-knit team serving some of the world’s largest enterprises.

We're hiring our first Global Account Managers to own and aggressively grow a small number of our largest global accounts — companies like Amazon, Microsoft, Google, Meta, and Salesforce.

Accounts of this scale are not one company; they're dozens. Amazon alone runs research across retail, devices, AWS, advertising, and entertainment, in a dozen countries, with separate budgets and separate buying centers in each. We're already inside these organizations and the teams who use us love us. What we don't yet have is someone whose entire job is to turn a strong foothold into an enterprise-wide standard. That's this role.

This is a senior individual contributor role reporting to the VP of Sales. You'll carry full commercial ownership of your accounts — expansion, cross-sell, pricing, and renewal — and an aggressive seven-figure growth target against them. You will not be working a wide territory or chasing net-new logos. You'll be going deep in a handful of the most important companies in the world, finding net new buying centers and getting introduced via referrals, building the relationships and the multi-year plan that make Outset the way they understand their customers.

You'll do it with a team around you. Each global account is supported by a dedicated account team — Sales Development, Research Operations, an Account Director, and a Solutions Consultant, with executive sponsorship from our leadership team. You set the strategy and direct the effort; the resources are there to execute it.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Own a portfolio of a small number of strategic global accounts — companies on the scale of Amazon, Microsoft, Google, Meta, and Salesforce — with full commercial responsibility for expansion, cross-sell, pricing, and renewal.
* Find new buying centers, both regionally and within the larger umbrella brand, to pursue, predominantly via deep account understanding, referrals and in-person visits.
* Carry and exceed an aggressive seven-figure growth target across that portfolio.
* Build and maintain a live global account plan for each logo: every buying center by business unit, region, and research function; whitespace and spend map; executive relationship map; competitive position; and a dated path to each expansion.
* Multi-thread relentlessly — from practicing researchers to VPs to the C-suite — and build senior relationships durable enough to survive champion turnover, reorgs, and procurement cycles.
* Direct the extended account team (Sales Development, Research Operations, Account Director, Solutions Consultant, Marketing, and executive sponsors), setting priorities and holding the plan together across functions and time zones.
* Run executive business reviews that reframe the relationship around business outcomes, not usage stats, and convert them into committed budgets.
* Negotiate and close complex enterprise agreements — global MSAs, enterprise-wide and multi-region commitments, multi-year structures, enterprise procurement, security and privacy review — in partnership with Legal, Finance, and leadership.
* Coordinate coverage globally, aligning our regional teams behind a single account strategy rather than a set of local ones.
* Forecast with precision and keep a clean, current view of your accounts in Salesforce.
* Bring the voice of your accounts back into Outset — informing product direction, pricing, and how we build the global account motion itself.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* 10+ years in enterprise sales, including 5+ years in a named global or strategic account role (Global Account Manager, Global Account Director, Strategic Account Manager, or equivalent) owning a small book of major brands.
* Direct experience selling into and growing accounts of this profile — large, global, matrixed technology or consumer organizations with many buying centers, such as Amazon, Microsoft, Google, Meta, or Salesforce.
* A proven record of exceeding aggressive seven-figure growth targets *inside existing accounts* — expansion, cross-sell, and renewal — not only net-new logo attainment.
* World-class relationship management. You are known for the depth and durability of the relationships you build, and you can point to accounts you grew over years, not quarters.
* Executive presence and commercial sharpness: credible with CxO and VP-level buyers, consultative enough to teach and shape their thinking, and comfortable negotiating at scale.
* Demonstrated ability to lead an extended, cross-functional account team without direct authority — you make the people around you more effective on your accounts.
* Experience navigating complex global commercial structures: multi-region contracting, enterprise procurement, multi-year commitments, and competing internal stakeholders.
* Operational rigor — a real account planning methodology, accurate forecasting, and CRM discipline.
* High ownership, opinionated, proactive, and comfortable with a very fast pace of both decision-making and execution in a startup that is still building the playbook.

jobs.title: Mental Health Case Manager
jobs.description:
**Organization Summary:** Established in 1993, Operation Dignity (OD) is a nonprofit organization that operates emergency, transitional, and permanent housing programs in Alameda County. Our mission is to create pathways to health and housing for the most vulnerable individuals experiencing homelessness in our community, with a special focus on veterans and people living in encampments. We help participants reach their housing goals by providing a continuum of service from comprehensive street outreach and shelter to permanent supportive housing. Among our core values are meeting people where they are while cultivating a strong peer community, inclusive of race, religion, gender, sexual orientation, and disability.

**Position Summary:** Operation Dignity Mental Health Case Managers provide comprehensive case management services for residents in our permanent supportive housing programs. Case Managers use a strength-based approach, valuing clients’ skills, resilience, and capacities to take charge of their lives. Case Managers support each resident to achieve their goals, maintain housing stability, substance abuse recovery, mental health improvements, and self-sufficiency.

**Essential Job Functions:**

**Essential Job Functions**

1. Case Management and Service Coordination

· Develop a trusting and consistent relationship with each resident that supports them to envision positive change, receive needed support, and achieve their goals.

· Maintain a respectful, caring, strength-based, and empowering relationship with all clients.

· Conduct a thorough psychosocial assessment to identify the client’s: unique story, risk factors to address, and strengths/resiliency factors to build upon for a successful program outcome.

· Engage clients to develop a self-sufficiency case plan, identifying the action steps to achieve their goals.

· Provide strength-based case management counseling on a weekly basis to support clients to achieve their self-sufficiency goals.

· Facilitate resident meetings and offer life skills training and education programs.

· Support residents with housing stability, money management, referrals to rental assistance programs, educating residents on the house rules and how to prepare for inspections.

· Coordinate services with community-based partners to ensure clients receive comprehensive services, including mental health, legal assistance, entitlement benefits, health care, substance abuse treatment, job training, and rental assistance.

· Intervene in crisis situations to help de-escalate clients, promote positive solutions, and re-establish stability in a community environment.

· Maintain cohesive relationships with property management, attend weekly property management meetings.

· Mediate any issues with property management and residents to avoid and/or mitigate lease violations. Implement case plan with action items for tenant sustaining services for evection prevention.

· Inform supervisors of crisis matters in a timely manner.

**2. Communications and Record-Keeping**

· Maintain thorough, accurate, and up-to-date files, including progress notes, case plans, and other pertinent documentation regarding services for each client.

· Input case notes and supportive services provided for each client in the Homeless Management Information System (HMIS). Complete all assessments in the HMIS system and Salesforce system.

· Enroll residents in Tenant Sustaining Services to provide ongoing support, promote housing stability, and assist with maintaining successful tenancy.

· Maintain professional relationships/boundaries with clients, while maintaining a strict level of confidentiality (in accordance with HIPAA).

· Participate in regular case conferences to review client progress.

· Participate in weekly staff meetings to discuss client progress and recommend community resources on behalf of each client.

· Follow up on incident reports in a timely manner until a satisfactory resolution is attained.

· Engage in respectful communications with staff and community partners.

**3. Staff Development and Organizational Culture**

· Receive regular supervision sessions to enhance skills and safeguard personal health and wellness.

· Participate in strategic planning, training, and team-building sessions, as requested.

· Help create a positive, productive, and supportive team and work environment.

· Perform other related duties, as assigned.

**Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities**

· Must have education and/or experience demonstrating knowledge of case management principles and required responsibilities.

· Experience with CalAim preferred.

· At least two years of experience working in a nonprofit or social service setting, particularly one serving people experiencing homelessness, mental health or substance abuse.

· Familiarity with Harm Reduction, Motivational Interviewing, and the 12-Step Addiction Recovery Model.

· One or more of the following certifications:

· Certified Addiction Treatment Counselor (CATC)

· Certified Alcoholism and Drug Abuse Counselor (CADAC)

· Registered Addiction Specialist (RAS)

· Certified Addiction Specialist (CAS)

· Other relevant certifications focused on mental health and/or substance use treatment.

· Experience in a mental health setting, such as community mental health service facilities, outpatient clinics, VA and hospital mental health offices, etc.

· Experience providing intensive case management, including providing Substance Use Disorder services.

· Experience providing outreach (direct engagement, service referrals, harm reduction supplies, etc.) to homeless individuals.

· Ability to create a compassionate, patient, and empowering connection with highly marginalized and homeless populations, including individuals with mental health and substance abuse concerns.

· Must have at least two years of relevant experience providing direct services to individuals who have been homeless, disabled, or economically marginalized.

jobs.description:
**About Airwallex**
-------------------

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles to see it in full.

### **How you'll make impact**

You’ll build and run the experimentation engine behind Airwallex’s global growth: what we test, how we test it, and how we know when we’re right.

* Own the end-to-end execution of growth experiments and campaigns, translating strategic hypotheses into operational workflows, coordinating launches and rollouts, and synthesising learnings to inform the next iteration.
* Manage the experimentation backlog, campaign calendar, measurement approach, tracking taxonomy, dashboards, QA processes, and reporting across Commercial, Growth, Product, Engineering, Marketing, Data and Legal.
* Identify gaps in tooling and process, then codify repeatable work into scalable systems, including checklists, QA scripts, readout templates and registry libraries. Use AI with clear guardrails and human review before anything customer-facing goes live.
* Partner with FP&A on forecasting and budget tracking, balancing speed with experimental rigour, data quality and effective cross-functional execution.

You’ll work from our San Francisco office on Mondays, Wednesdays and Thursdays.

### **What we're looking for**

**Essentials**

* 2+ years of experience in growth, operations, product management, or strategy roles
* Demonstrated ability to manage complex projects with multiple stakeholders and dependencies
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with comfort working with data and metrics
* Experience designing or coordinating experiments, with familiarity with A/B testing methodology
* Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to synthesise and present insights clearly
* Ability to execute in ambiguity and adapt quickly to changing priorities

**Preferred**

* You understand holdouts, statistical power and significance, and you’re fluent in SQL and/or analytics tools such as Hex or Looker
* You can build and QA campaigns across lifecycle, martech and CDP tooling, and you use automation and AI to make repeatable work scale with appropriate guardrails
* You’ve partnered with Engineering and Data teams to deploy experiments at scale
* You can prioritise high-impact opportunities, say no to good ideas when needed, and defend decisions with evidence
* You move easily between Commercial, Product, Marketing, Data and Legal
* You’ve worked in SaaS, fintech or another high-growth technology company and are comfortable with agile and product development methodologies
* Experience with growth operations, A/B testing, project management, campaign management, roadmap planning, SQL or Python, stakeholder management and cross-functional coordination

### **You'll thrive here if**

* You’re comfortable owning the roadmap yourself.
* You own the outcome and you don’t wait for permission to fix what’s broken.
* You’re not precious about your ideas. You push hard for what you believe in, but you pivot fast when the data says otherwise.
* You’re comfortable with ambiguity. Give you a problem, not a prescription, and you’ll run with it.
* You connect dots across functions and hold the big picture without losing grip on the details.

### **Learn more about your team**

Growth at Airwallex is building a unified, AI-native growth system across product, sales, and marketing. Rather than applying AI to isolated tasks, we use customer context, machine learning, automation, and continuous learning to transform how Airwallex acquires, activates, converts, retains, and expands customers.

You’ll build high-traffic platforms, experimentation frameworks, and intelligent decision systems that turn signals—such as company profile, product usage, lifecycle stage, behavior, and intent—into personalized journeys, next-best actions, and measurable incremental value.

The work spans both human + AI and autonomous operating models: AI-native tools that increase the leverage of growth teams, alongside agentic workflows that can research opportunities, launch and optimize campaigns, orchestrate customer journeys, and measure outcomes within clear strategies and guardrails.

The challenge is to combine consumer-technology speed with the precision, trust, and regulatory complexity of global B2B finance. If you enjoy owning ambiguous problems end to end, prototyping quickly, measuring real business impact, and using every outcome to improve the next decision, you’ll help define how an AI-native global financial platform grows.

jobs.description:
Join us in pioneering breakthroughs in healthcare. For everyone. Everywhere. Sustainably.  
  
Our inspiring and caring environment forms a global community that celebrates diversity and individuality. We encourage you to step beyond your comfort zone, offering resources and flexibility to foster your professional and personal growth, all while valuing your unique contributions.

We are seeking a highly analytical and detail-oriented **Senior Sales Operations Analyst** to support the effectiveness and scalability of our commercial organization. This role will serve as a key subject matter expert for CRM platforms, sales compensation, commercial analytics, and sales operations processes.

The **Senior** **Sales Operations Analyst** will partner closely with Sales Leadership, Finance, and other cross-functional stakeholders to maintain high-quality commercial data, administer and analyze incentive compensation programs, develop actionable reporting, and continuously improve the tools and processes used by the sales organization.

The ideal candidate combines strong technical data analysis capabilities with an understanding of sales compensation, commercial performance metrics, and the day-to-day needs of a high-performing sales organization.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Serve as a key **CRM expert** for the commercial organization, supporting CRM processes, reporting, dashboards, data quality, and user adoption.
* Develop and maintain Salesforce reports and dashboards that provide visibility into sales activity, pipeline, performance, account management, and other key commercial metrics.
* Partner with Sales Leadership and business stakeholders to translate business requirements into scalable Salesforce solutions and process improvements.
* Monitor CRM data quality and establish processes to improve data accuracy, completeness, consistency, and governance.
* Support the administration and ongoing management of **sales incentive compensation programs**.
* Perform recurring sales compensation calculations and validations to ensure accurate and timely incentive payments.
* Model potential compensation plan changes and assess impact.
* Develop compensation statements, dashboards, and reporting that provide sales representatives and leadership with clear visibility into performance and incentive attainment.
* Support annual sales compensation planning, quota setting, and plan implementation.
* Develop and maintain recurring and ad hoc reporting on sales performance, productivity, pipeline, forecasting, incentive attainment, and other commercial KPIs.
* Analyze sales results to identify trends, performance gaps, opportunities, and potential risks.
* Translate complex data into clear insights and recommendations for Sales Leadership.
* Create executive-ready dashboards and reporting that enable data-driven commercial decisions.

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Data Analytics, Information Systems, or a related field.
* 5+ years of experience in Sales Operations, Commercial Operations, Revenue Operations, Sales Analytics, or a related function.

* Experience supporting or administering sales incentive compensation programs.
* Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including complex formulas, lookups, pivot tables, data validation, and large-data-set analysis.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with exceptional attention to detail.
* Ability to translate business requirements into reporting, system, and process solutions.
* Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively cross-functionally.

* Experience with sales compensation platforms or incentive compensation management systems.
* Experience with BI and visualization tools such as Power BI or Tableau.
* Experience supporting quota setting, territory design, or sales planning.
* Experience in medical device, life sciences, or other healthcare related field.

**Preferred Requirements**

* Experience with sales compensation platforms or incentive compensation management systems.
* Experience with SQL or other data-querying tools.
* Experience utilizing SAP or similar order management tools.
* Experience supporting quota setting, territory design, or sales planning.
* Experience working within a complex, matrixed commercial organization.
