jobs.title: Intake Operations Supervisor
jobs.description:
Koya is always looking for curious and passionate individuals who want to join a fast-paced team for a career in transforming venous and lymphatic care through innovative people-centric technologies that improve lives and empower self-care. Koya values integrity, humility, hard-work, camaraderie, and fun. We offer a base + bonus compensation package, and a competitive benefits program.

**Position Summary**

The Supervisor, Sales Support & Patient Intake leads and unites the teams responsible for guiding patients and providers through every step of the Dayspring order journey — from first referral through document collection and order fulfillment. This role brings together the Sales Support and Intake Operations functions under one team-first leader who builds a culture of collaboration, accountability, and shared ownership of the patient and sales experience.

This role is focused primarily on people leadership between the two departments. The Supervisor coaches, develops, and motivates team members across both functions, removes obstacles that stand between the team and its goals, and ensures the two groups operate as a single, well-coordinated unit rather than two disconnected teams handing work back and forth. The ideal candidate is an engaged, hands-on leader who genuinely enjoys developing people, building trust, and creating an environment where the team feels supported, recognized, and set up to succeed — while also ensuring orders are processed accurately, compliantly, and on time.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

Team Leadership & Development

* Lead, coach, and support a combined team of Sales Support and Intake Operations Representatives, fostering one connected team culture across both functions.
* Hold regular one-on-ones, team huddles, and performance check-ins to keep team members engaged, supported, and growing in their roles.
* Recruit, onboard, and train new team members; build structured ramp plans so new hires reach full productivity quickly and confidently.
* Identify skill and development opportunities for each team member, and create pathways for cross-training between the Sales Support and Intake Operations functions to build a more versatile, resilient team.
* Recognize and celebrate individual and team wins; actively contribute to a positive, high-trust team environment where people want to do their best work.
* Conduct performance evaluations, set goals collaboratively with team members, and address performance concerns with fairness and consistency.
* Manage team scheduling, workload balancing, and PTO coverage to ensure consistent service levels for sales, referral sources, and patients.

**Operational Oversight**

* Ensure the team collects, verifies, and processes all documentation required to support order fulfillment, including patient demographics, physician orders, and supporting clinical documentation, and provides basic benefit investigation support as needed.
* Serve as the escalation point for complex order, intake, or documentation issues that the team cannot resolve independently.
* Monitor team-wide KPIs — order accuracy, turnaround time, referral conversion, and documentation completeness — and partner with the team to problem-solve when targets are at risk.
* Partner closely with Sales, Reimbursement Operations, Billing, and Fulfillment teams to eliminate friction and hand-off delays between sales support and patient intake.
* Champion and build shared, standardized processes across both functions. Lead both teams to improve consistency, efficiency, and the experience for patients, providers, and the sales team.
* Maintain a working knowledge of third-party payer guidelines, as outlined in the Company's Payer Library, to support the Reimbursement Operations team.
* Ensure the team's practices reflect current knowledge of HIPAA, TJC, and other federal/state regulatory requirements, and maintain awareness of compliance requirements for federally funded healthcare programs (e.g., Medicare and Medicaid) regarding fraud, waste, and abuse. Elevate compliance questions or concerns promptly and take appropriate action on issues reported by the team.
* Maintain accurate records, including patient protected health information, in the CRM (Salesforce.com) and other internal systems.
* Contribute to continuous process improvement initiatives that enhance team efficiency and the overall patient and referral experience.

**Minimum Qualifications**

Education, Experience & Training

* Bachelor's degree preferred
* At least 5 years of experience in sales support, patient intake, customer service, healthcare administration, or the DME industry
* At least 2 years of experience leading, supervising, or mentoring a team preferred
* Experience with benefit verification, medical documentation, or order processing preferred

**Knowledge, Skills & Abilities**

* Demonstrated passion for developing people and building strong, cohesive teams
* Strong coaching, motivational, and conflict-resolution skills
* Excellent organizational, time management, and multitasking abilities
* Effective oral and written communication and relationship-building skills across all levels of the organization
* Ability to lead confidently and resourcefully in a fast-paced, deadline-driven, and growing company
* Proactive, solutions-oriented mindset with sound judgment under pressure
* Proficiency in CRM systems (Salesforce.com preferred) and Microsoft Office
* High ethical standards and sound judgment handling sensitive patient information

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Team engagement, retention, and satisfaction
* Combined order accuracy and completeness rate across Sales Support and Intake
* Turnaround time from referral/order receipt to closure
* Reduction in delays caused by hand-offs between Sales Support and Intake
* Sales team and referral source satisfaction
* Compliance with payer and regulatory requirements
* New hire ramp time and cross-training completion

**WHY MILLCRAFT**  
At Millcraft, we’re more than a business, we’re a family. For over 100 years, we’ve been proud to serve the paper, packaging, and graphic arts industries, guided by our values of Family, Passion, Aspire, Responsible, and Deliver. Come join us and be part of something truly special.

Reporting to the Director of Operations, the primary responsibility of the Operations Manager is to manage and oversee the day-to-day functions within the distribution center in establishing and maintaining efficient and effective processes in the flow of merchandise in and out of the facility. The Operations Manager is responsible to assure growth, diversification and learning among all Operations team members. This role requires strong leadership, strategic thinking, and the ability to optimize workflows, resources, and personnel to achieve operational excellence.

* Make recommendations to increase sales, decrease expenses and improve profitability
* Coordinate and communicate with other divisions and support departments and stores to ensure that the right product is in the right place at the right time
* Ensure that all loss prevention and security guidelines are followed
* Support and drive operational changes and build a “learning” culture

* Support the effective use of Millcraft’s ERP system and provide training and retraining to all Operations employees
* Follow all Millcraft policies, procedures, and guidelines as outlined in the employee handbook and departmental SOPs
* Ensure a safe working environment by strictly following all safety protocols and standards including reporting unsafe conditions, near-misses and incidents immediately to your manager
* Demonstrate the Millcraft Core Values (Family, Responsible, Passion, Deliver, Aspire and FUN) in day-to-day work and interactions
* Other duties as needed for the business.

**WHAT YOU’LL NEED TO SUCCEED**

* Technically oriented - daily use of Microsoft Office including but not limited to Outlook, Excel, and Word. Warehousing – advanced warehouse systems highly preferred including RF
* Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to prioritize tasks and manage multiple projects simultaneously.
* Ability to multi-task
* Strong leadership and communication skills, with the ability to inspire and motivate teams to achieve performance goals
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to analyze data, identify trends, and make data-driven decisions.
* Proven commitment to safety and wellness in the workplace
* Ability to travel
* Ability to lift up to 70 lbs. and participate in manual activities – for training purposes and other
* Bachelor’s degree preferred
* Experience in a paper and/or packaging environment is preferred
* Proven experience in operations management, with at least 3 years of experience in a leadership role
* Ensure compliance with safety and company procedures, and actively embody our core values in every interaction and responsibility. (Include in all JD’s)

**WHAT WINNING LOOKS LIKE**

* Ability to lift items that weigh a minimum of 70lbs regularly
* Ability to stand for long periods of time
* Ability to bend, stoop and climb repetitiously throughout the day

jobs.title: Project Manager (Part-Time, HubSpot)
jobs.description:
**About the role**

AmplifyOps is a HubSpot implementation and RevOps consultancy based in Tulsa, OK, working with a portfolio of clients across associations, SaaS, media, and professional services. Our team of HubSpot admins, Service Hub specialists, data people, and developers does the technical work. We need someone who keeps that work moving and keeps clients informed.

This is a part-time Project Manager role, augmenting our staff on specific client projects. You own the schedule, the follow-ups, and the client relationship between calls. You should be comfortable working inside HubSpot day to day and know it well enough to understand what the team is building, ask the right questions, and explain status to a client without a translator. You don’t need to be a HubSpot wizard; the technical depth lives with our admins and developers.

The person who thrives here is organized, unflappable, and good in a room. Clients should feel calmer after talking to you, and the team should trust that nothing falls through the cracks.

**What you’ll do**

* Run 1-2 active client projects at a time: keep each one scoped, scheduled, and on track against the SOW
* Own client communication between meetings. Send recap emails within 24 hours of every call, with decisions, owners, and next steps
* Chase what’s outstanding. Follow up with clients on open requests, access, approvals, and content, and with our team on deliverables, without being asked
* Lead client status calls and kickoffs. Set the agenda, keep the room on track, and close with clear next steps
* Translate between clients and the technical team: turn a client’s request into a clear ask for our admins and developers, and turn their work into plain-language updates for the client
* Keep project tracking current in HubSpot and our internal tools (Supered, Slack, Google Drive, Clockify) so anyone on the team can see status at a glance
* Flag risk early. If scope is creeping, a deadline is slipping, or a client has gone quiet, raise it before it becomes a problem
* Support the weekly rhythm: internal project reviews, partner touchpoints, and end-of-week status summaries

**Must-haves**

* Hands-on HubSpot experience: you know your way around contacts, companies, deals, pipelines, workflows, and the Marketing, Sales, and Service Hubs well enough to follow a technical conversation, check on progress yourself, and explain it back to a client. Solid, not expert; the advanced build work is handled by our admins and developers
* The ability to task work clearly across all our resources. You turn a client need into a well-scoped assignment, matched to the right person (admin, Service Hub specialist, data, or development), with context, a definition of done, and a due date, so nobody has to come back and ask what you meant
* 2+ years managing client-facing projects, ideally at an agency, consultancy, or professional services firm
* A calm, confident presence with clients. You can run a call with a frustrated stakeholder, hold the room, and leave everyone clear on what happens next
* Clear, fast written communication. Your recap emails are short, specific, and go out the same day
* Relentless follow-through. You keep your own lists, nothing waits on a reminder from someone else, and you are comfortable nudging people (politely, repeatedly) until things close

**Nice-to-haves**

* HubSpot certifications (Marketing Software, Sales Software, Service Hub, or Reporting)
* Experience with RevOps, marketing operations, or CRM migrations
* Familiarity with Supered, Clockify, PandaDoc, or Zendesk
* Experience managing contractors or partner agencies alongside an internal team

**Details**

* **Hours:** Part-time, roughly 5-10 hours per week, with availability for client calls during US business hours
* **Location:** Remote, must be located in the USA.
* **Type:** Contractor. Part-time for now, augmenting our staff on specific client projects, with room to expand as the client base grows
* **Compensation:** $30-$40/hour, or a negotiated flat rate per project

Pay: $30.00 - $40.00 per hour

PURPOSE

jobs.title: Quality Assurance Lead
jobs.description:
The QA Lead is accountable for the quality assurance practice across product delivery, ensuring that software is testable, test execution is timely and transparent, critical defects are surfaced early, and releases meet agreed quality standards. This role leads day-to-day QA planning and execution, strengthens automation and regression coverage, coaches QA team members, and works closely with Product Owners and Engineering to embed quality throughout the software development lifecycle rather than treating testing as a final-stage activity.  
  
The QA Lead is expected to create clear visibility into test readiness, progress, risk, and blockers. The role owns the operating discipline of QA: defining test approaches, ensuring execution begins when planned, maintaining useful quality metrics, driving defect triage, and escalating issues early when delivery or release quality is at risk.  
  
**Key Responsibilities**  
  
Quality Leadership & Accountability

* Own the day-to-day QA practice and establish consistent expectations for test planning, execution, documentation, and release readiness.
* Ensure QA work begins when planned and that delays, blockers, environment issues, data needs, or scope gaps are identified and communicated immediately.
* Create transparency into what has been tested, what remains untested, current defects, quality risks, and confidence in release readiness.
* Hold QA team members accountable for execution commitments, timely updates, accurate status reporting, and follow-through.
* Coach QA team members on testing discipline, risk-based thinking, root-cause analysis, and stronger ownership of outcomes.

Test Strategy, Planning & Execution

* Develop and maintain test strategies for new features, enhancements, integrations, defects, and platform changes.
* Partner with Product Owners early in discovery and refinement to identify test scenarios, edge cases, data needs, dependencies, and acceptance criteria before development is complete.
* Ensure test cases provide adequate functional, integration, regression, negative, end-to-end, and workflow coverage based on business and technical risk.
* Coordinate test data, environments, integrations, and dependencies required for successful QA execution.
* Confirm that critical workflows can be tested end-to-end before work is considered ready for business UAT.
* Use risk-based testing to prioritize the highest-value scenarios when time or environment constraints require tradeoffs.

Defect Management & Release Readiness

* Lead defect triage in partnership with Product and Engineering, ensuring severity, priority, business impact, and ownership are clear.
* Track critical defects through resolution and retest and ensure unresolved quality risks are explicitly documented before release decisions.
* Define and enforce practical QA exit criteria, including expectations for critical defect closure, regression completion, and stability.
* Provide an objective quality recommendation for releases based on test evidence and known risk.
* Identify recurring defect patterns and partner with Engineering and Product on preventive actions rather than relying only on downstream testing.

Automation & Continuous Improvement

* Develop and maintain a pragmatic test automation strategy focused on high-value regression, repeatable workflows, integrations, and business-critical scenarios.
* Partner with QA Automation Engineers and Engineering to increase reliable automated coverage without creating brittle or low-value automation.
* Use modern AI-assisted tools, where appropriate, to accelerate test-case creation, test-data design, automation development, and quality analysis while preserving human review and accountability.
* Evaluate test tooling, frameworks, and processes and recommend improvements that increase efficiency, coverage, and maintainability.
* Reduce manual regression effort over time by identifying the strongest candidates for automation and incorporating automated tests into delivery pipelines where feasible.

Cross-Functional Partnership

* Work closely with Product Owners to ensure requirements and acceptance criteria are clear, testable, and aligned to expected business outcomes.
* Partner with Engineering on defect prevention, unit/integration test expectations, environment stability, observability, and root-cause analysis.
* Collaborate with Architecture and platform teams when quality issues involve integration, infrastructure, data movement, or systemic technical risk.
* Support business UAT by ensuring the product is genuinely ready for validation and by helping distinguish blocking defects from non-blocking follow-up work.
* Communicate quality risk in clear business terms so leadership can make informed release and prioritization decisions.

Metrics & Reporting

* Maintain a small, actionable set of QA metrics that reflect product quality and execution health rather than activity alone.
* Track measures such as test execution progress, escaped defects, defect severity, defect reopen rate, regression coverage, automation coverage, UAT rework, and recurring defect trends.
* Use metrics to identify systemic improvement opportunities and to show whether changes to process, automation, or requirements quality are producing measurable results.
* Provide concise status reporting that clearly states current quality, material risks, blockers, required decisions, and next actions.

**Required Qualifications**

* Significant hands-on experience in software quality assurance, including functional, integration, regression, and end-to-end testing.
* Experience leading QA execution, mentoring testers, or functioning as a senior/lead resource responsible for quality outcomes.
* Strong understanding of Agile/Scrum delivery and the role of QA throughout discovery, development, testing, UAT, and release.
* Demonstrated ability to create test strategies and translate complex business workflows into thorough, risk-based test coverage.
*

**Background Check Requirement**

As part of our hiring process, Frontline Wildfire Defense conducts comprehensive background checks for all new hires. These checks typically cover the past 7–10 years and may include employment and education verification. For roles that require work in the field, driving record verification is also required. Employment offers are contingent upon the successful completion of these background checks.

**About Frontline Wildfire Defense**

Founded in 2017, Frontline developed the first fully integrated wildfire defense system to stop the leading cause of home loss in wildfires: ember-driven ignition. The system combines exterior sprinklers, full-coverage design, and connected software for remote monitoring and response, allowing homes to protect themselves long after families evacuate or infrastructure fails.

Proven effective during the 2025 Los Angeles wildfires, 96% of homes with Frontline systems survived. That success has earned top industry recognition, including Frontline being recognized as one of TIME's Best Inventions 2025 in the Green Tech category and receiving the PCBC Gold Nugget Award for "Most Innovative Housing Concept" and the Best of IBS Award for "Best Home Technology."

As wildfires grow hotter and more frequent, our vision is to give people the tools and strategies to live safely with fire. We're building a mission-driven team creating real-world solutions in wildfire safety and climate tech.

As Customer Success Manager, you will build and lead the team that stands behind every Frontline customer, from the day their system is installed through every fire season after. You will own Frontline's customer support function and lead our Wildfire Response Specialists, the team that helps homeowners and commercial customers make sure their systems are ready, running, and doing their job when a wildfire is approaching.

Every Frontline system is designed to protect a property even after its owners have evacuated. Our fire-tracking software alerts customers when a wildfire comes within ten miles and starts an automatic activation countdown. Each system has a connected controller with Wi-Fi, cellular, and satellite connectivity and a backup battery. When it activates, eave sprayers and roof rotors wet the home and up to 30 feet around it with water and Class A foam. The Care Manager Team Lead at Prevounce Health will provide daily leadership, coaching, and operational support to a team of Care Managers while ensuring high-quality patient care and efficient workflows. This role focuses on monitoring team performance, coordinating with clinics, maintaining accurate documentation, and supporting patient outreach and care management activities. The ideal candidate has hands-on care management experience, strong communication and leadership skills, and the ability to balance team oversight with direct patient support in a fast-paced, remote healthcare environment.

### **About Prevounce Health**

Prevounce is an innovative startup focused on creating software applications and connected medical devices that empower medical professionals to provide better remote patient care. Our cloud platform and other products are trusted by leading clinicians, hospital groups and health insurance companies to reduce costs, increase revenue while driving better health outcomes for patients. We have seen significant adoption of our products since launching in 2020 and are seeking talented and motivated individuals to join our tight-knit but growing team.

### **Description**

Position Overview

The Bilingual Care Manager Team Lead provides day-to-day leadership and workflow support for the Care Managers assigned to the clinic(s). This working lead position helps ensure that patient care activities, documentation, outreach, care-plan tasks, and clinic communications are completed accurately, consistently, and within established timelines during Pacific Time operating hours.

The Team Lead serves as the first point of contact for routine team questions and escalations, monitors team performance and workload, and partners with Care Management leadership to maintain a high-quality experience for patients and the clinic. The position also maintains an assigned patient workload or provides direct care-management coverage based on operational needs.

Key Responsibilities

* Team Leadership: Provide daily guidance, coaching, and workflow support to Care Managers assigned to the clinic(s).
* Workflow Oversight: Monitor daily queues, patient assignments, clinical messages, care-plan tasks, outreach activity, and outstanding documentation to ensure timely completion.
* Clinic Coordination: Serve as a primary operational contact for clinic(s) needs and maintain clear communication between the clinic, Care Managers, and internal leadership.
* Patient Care Support: Maintain an assigned patient workload or provide coverage as needed, including patient outreach, education, care coordination, and follow-up within the applicable care management programs.

logistics supporting Order Management demands. Serving as the primary escalation point and

operations, supply chain teams, and partner engagement teams. This role applies deep

standards.

and vendor networks regarding complex order inquiries, delays, and critical supply  
bottlenecks.

order pipelines.

identify operational bottlenecks and implement process improvements.

windows or when senior operations management is unavailable.

partnership, and proactive risk mitigation

Qualifications

Information Systems, or equivalent professional experience.

deployments

environments with a collaborative leadership style, a positive can-do mindset and a passion for operational excellence

equipment, optical hardware, cabling, power/cooling assets) or managing specialized logistics operations

data and drive actionable operational decisions

escalations under tight deadlines with proven stakeholder management

Scribd, Inc. is on a mission to advance human understanding. Our four products — Scribd, Slideshare, Everand, and Fable — help billions of people across the globe move beyond access and into insight, application, and expertise.

**Culture at Scribd, Inc.**
---------------------------

We support a culture where our employees can be real and be bold; where we debate and commit as we embrace plot twists; and where every employee is empowered to take action as we prioritize the customer.

We believe the best work happens when individual flexibility is balanced with meaningful community connection. Scribd Flex empowers employees to choose the workstyle and location that support their best performance, while committing to intentional in-person moments that strengthen collaboration and culture. Occasional in-person attendance is required for all Scribd, Inc. employees, regardless of location.

So what are we looking for in new team members? At Scribd, Inc., we hire for “GRIT.” Traditionally defined as the intersection of passion and perseverance toward long-term goals, GRIT reflects the mindset we expect from every employee. For us, it also serves as a practical framework for how we work: setting and achieving Goals, delivering Results within your role, contributing Innovative ideas and solutions, and strengthening the broader Team through collaboration and attitude.

**About The Team and Role:**

Customer Operations is the backbone of trust and reliability for readers, listeners, and creators across our products. Our team makes sure every support interaction, whether with a paying subscriber or a creator publishing on our platform, is handled with quality, consistency, and care. As Senior Training & Quality Assurance Strategist, you’ll build the training and quality program that helps every customer get consistently great support, whether from our internal teams or our outsourced partners. You’ll design the curriculum, quality rubrics, and calibration process that turn quality from something we measure after the fact into something we build in from the start. This is a foundational role: you’ll shape what great support looks like across Customer Operations and build a program that can scale with us. You’ll also use what quality and training reveal to influence how we work, helping teams find better, smarter ways to get things done. You’ll lead through influence, partnering closely with the leaders who manage the people doing the work.

**About You:**
--------------

You’re a builder who can connect the pieces we have today into one structured, proactive program, and you know the difference between a training program that looks good on paper and one that actually changes performance. You take initiative without waiting for direction and stay comfortable with ambiguity, including in a remote environment. You can get buy-in and drive real change across teams you don’t manage, through credibility and relationships, not a reporting line. That means carrying yourself with confidence in front of leaders, challenging a decision respectfully, and bringing people along. You think in systems: you don’t just fix the immediate error, you look for what let it happen in the first place.

* Own an ongoing, company-wide customer advocacy training program, a “day in the life” of Customer Operations, so everyone understands our customers’ experiences

new_jobs.title: Mental Health Case Manager
new_jobs.description:
**Organization Summary:** Established in 1993, Operation Dignity (OD) is a nonprofit organization that operates emergency, transitional, and permanent housing programs in Alameda County. Our mission is to create pathways to health and housing for the most vulnerable individuals experiencing homelessness in our community, with a special focus on veterans and people living in encampments. We help participants reach their housing goals by providing a continuum of service from comprehensive street outreach and shelter to permanent supportive housing. Among our core values are meeting people where they are while cultivating a strong peer community, inclusive of race, religion, gender, sexual orientation, and disability.

**Position Summary:** Operation Dignity Mental Health Case Managers provide comprehensive case management services for residents in our permanent supportive housing programs. Case Managers use a strength-based approach, valuing clients’ skills, resilience, and capacities to take charge of their lives. Case Managers support each resident to achieve their goals, maintain housing stability, substance abuse recovery, mental health improvements, and self-sufficiency.

**Essential Job Functions:**

**Essential Job Functions**

1. Case Management and Service Coordination

· Develop a trusting and consistent relationship with each resident that supports them to envision positive change, receive needed support, and achieve their goals.

· Maintain a respectful, caring, strength-based, and empowering relationship with all clients.

· Conduct a thorough psychosocial assessment to identify the client’s: unique story, risk factors to address, and strengths/resiliency factors to build upon for a successful program outcome.

· Engage clients to develop a self-sufficiency case plan, identifying the action steps to achieve their goals.

· Provide strength-based case management counseling on a weekly basis to support clients to achieve their self-sufficiency goals.

· Facilitate resident meetings and offer life skills training and education programs.

· Support residents with housing stability, money management, referrals to rental assistance programs, educating residents on the house rules and how to prepare for inspections.

· Coordinate services with community-based partners to ensure clients receive comprehensive services, including mental health, legal assistance, entitlement benefits, health care, substance abuse treatment, job training, and rental assistance.

· Intervene in crisis situations to help de-escalate clients, promote positive solutions, and re-establish stability in a community environment.

· Maintain cohesive relationships with property management, attend weekly property management meetings.

· Mediate any issues with property management and residents to avoid and/or mitigate lease violations. Implement case plan with action items for tenant sustaining services for evection prevention.

· Inform supervisors of crisis matters in a timely manner.

**2. Communications and Record-Keeping**

· Maintain thorough, accurate, and up-to-date files, including progress notes, case plans, and other pertinent documentation regarding services for each client.

· Input case notes and supportive services provided for each client in the Homeless Management Information System (HMIS). Complete all assessments in the HMIS system and Salesforce system.

· Enroll residents in Tenant Sustaining Services to provide ongoing support, promote housing stability, and assist with maintaining successful tenancy.

· Maintain professional relationships/boundaries with clients, while maintaining a strict level of confidentiality (in accordance with HIPAA).

· Participate in regular case conferences to review client progress.

· Participate in weekly staff meetings to discuss client progress and recommend community resources on behalf of each client.

· Follow up on incident reports in a timely manner until a satisfactory resolution is attained.

· Engage in respectful communications with staff and community partners.

**3. Staff Development and Organizational Culture**

· Receive regular supervision sessions to enhance skills and safeguard personal health and wellness.

· Participate in strategic planning, training, and team-building sessions, as requested.

· Help create a positive, productive, and supportive team and work environment.

· Perform other related duties, as assigned.

**Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities**

· Must have education and/or experience demonstrating knowledge of case management principles and required responsibilities.

· Experience with CalAim preferred.

· At least two years of experience working in a nonprofit or social service setting, particularly one serving people experiencing homelessness, mental health or substance abuse.

· Familiarity with Harm Reduction, Motivational Interviewing, and the 12-Step Addiction Recovery Model.

· One or more of the following certifications:

· Certified Addiction Treatment Counselor (CATC)

· Certified Alcoholism and Drug Abuse Counselor (CADAC)

· Registered Addiction Specialist (RAS)

· Certified Addiction Specialist (CAS)

· Other relevant certifications focused on mental health and/or substance use treatment.

· Experience in a mental health setting, such as community mental health service facilities, outpatient clinics, VA and hospital mental health offices, etc.

· Experience providing intensive case management, including providing Substance Use Disorder services.

· Experience providing outreach (direct engagement, service referrals, harm reduction supplies, etc.) to homeless individuals.

· Ability to create a compassionate, patient, and empowering connection with highly marginalized and homeless populations, including individuals with mental health and substance abuse concerns.

· Must have at least two years of relevant experience providing direct services to individuals who have been homeless, disabled, or economically marginalized.

new_jobs.title: Senior Associate, Growth Strategy & Operations (Experiments/Campaigns)
new_jobs.description:
**About Airwallex**
-------------------

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles to see it in full.

### **How you'll make impact**

You’ll build and run the experimentation engine behind Airwallex’s global growth: what we test, how we test it, and how we know when we’re right.

* Own the end-to-end execution of growth experiments and campaigns, translating strategic hypotheses into operational workflows, coordinating launches and rollouts, and synthesising learnings to inform the next iteration.
* Manage the experimentation backlog, campaign calendar, measurement approach, tracking taxonomy, dashboards, QA processes, and reporting across Commercial, Growth, Product, Engineering, Marketing, Data and Legal.
* Identify gaps in tooling and process, then codify repeatable work into scalable systems, including checklists, QA scripts, readout templates and registry libraries. Use AI with clear guardrails and human review before anything customer-facing goes live.
* Partner with FP&A on forecasting and budget tracking, balancing speed with experimental rigour, data quality and effective cross-functional execution.

You’ll work from our San Francisco office on Mondays, Wednesdays and Thursdays.

### **What we're looking for**

**Essentials**

* 2+ years of experience in growth, operations, product management, or strategy roles
* Demonstrated ability to manage complex projects with multiple stakeholders and dependencies
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with comfort working with data and metrics
* Experience designing or coordinating experiments, with familiarity with A/B testing methodology
* Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to synthesise and present insights clearly
* Ability to execute in ambiguity and adapt quickly to changing priorities

**Preferred**

* You understand holdouts, statistical power and significance, and you’re fluent in SQL and/or analytics tools such as Hex or Looker
* You can build and QA campaigns across lifecycle, martech and CDP tooling, and you use automation and AI to make repeatable work scale with appropriate guardrails
* You’ve partnered with Engineering and Data teams to deploy experiments at scale
* You can prioritise high-impact opportunities, say no to good ideas when needed, and defend decisions with evidence
* You move easily between Commercial, Product, Marketing, Data and Legal
* You’ve worked in SaaS, fintech or another high-growth technology company and are comfortable with agile and product development methodologies
* Experience with growth operations, A/B testing, project management, campaign management, roadmap planning, SQL or Python, stakeholder management and cross-functional coordination

### **You'll thrive here if**

* You’re comfortable owning the roadmap yourself.
* You own the outcome and you don’t wait for permission to fix what’s broken.
* You’re not precious about your ideas. You push hard for what you believe in, but you pivot fast when the data says otherwise.
* You’re comfortable with ambiguity. Give you a problem, not a prescription, and you’ll run with it.
* You connect dots across functions and hold the big picture without losing grip on the details.

### **Learn more about your team**

Growth at Airwallex is building a unified, AI-native growth system across product, sales, and marketing. Rather than applying AI to isolated tasks, we use customer context, machine learning, automation, and continuous learning to transform how Airwallex acquires, activates, converts, retains, and expands customers.

You’ll build high-traffic platforms, experimentation frameworks, and intelligent decision systems that turn signals—such as company profile, product usage, lifecycle stage, behavior, and intent—into personalized journeys, next-best actions, and measurable incremental value.

The work spans both human + AI and autonomous operating models: AI-native tools that increase the leverage of growth teams, alongside agentic workflows that can research opportunities, launch and optimize campaigns, orchestrate customer journeys, and measure outcomes within clear strategies and guardrails.

The challenge is to combine consumer-technology speed with the precision, trust, and regulatory complexity of global B2B finance. If you enjoy owning ambiguous problems end to end, prototyping quickly, measuring real business impact, and using every outcome to improve the next decision, you’ll help define how an AI-native global financial platform grows.

The Supervisor, Sales Support & Patient Intake leads and unites the teams responsible for guiding patients and providers through every step of the Dayspring order journey — from first referral through document collection and order fulfillment. This role brings together the Sales Support and Intake Operations functions under one team-first leader who builds a culture of collaboration, accountability, and shared ownership of the patient and sales experience.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

Team Leadership & Development

new_jobs.title: Quality Assurance Lead
new_jobs.description:
The QA Lead is accountable for the quality assurance practice across product delivery, ensuring that software is testable, test execution is timely and transparent, critical defects are surfaced early, and releases meet agreed quality standards. This role leads day-to-day QA planning and execution, strengthens automation and regression coverage, coaches QA team members, and works closely with Product Owners and Engineering to embed quality throughout the software development lifecycle rather than treating testing as a final-stage activity.  
  
The QA Lead is expected to create clear visibility into test readiness, progress, risk, and blockers. The role owns the operating discipline of QA: defining test approaches, ensuring execution begins when planned, maintaining useful quality metrics, driving defect triage, and escalating issues early when delivery or release quality is at risk.  
  
**Key Responsibilities**  
  
Quality Leadership & Accountability

* Own the day-to-day QA practice and establish consistent expectations for test planning, execution, documentation, and release readiness.
* Ensure QA work begins when planned and that delays, blockers, environment issues, data needs, or scope gaps are identified and communicated immediately.
* Create transparency into what has been tested, what remains untested, current defects, quality risks, and confidence in release readiness.
* Hold QA team members accountable for execution commitments, timely updates, accurate status reporting, and follow-through.
* Coach QA team members on testing discipline, risk-based thinking, root-cause analysis, and stronger ownership of outcomes.

Test Strategy, Planning & Execution

* Develop and maintain test strategies for new features, enhancements, integrations, defects, and platform changes.
* Partner with Product Owners early in discovery and refinement to identify test scenarios, edge cases, data needs, dependencies, and acceptance criteria before development is complete.
* Ensure test cases provide adequate functional, integration, regression, negative, end-to-end, and workflow coverage based on business and technical risk.
* Coordinate test data, environments, integrations, and dependencies required for successful QA execution.
* Confirm that critical workflows can be tested end-to-end before work is considered ready for business UAT.
* Use risk-based testing to prioritize the highest-value scenarios when time or environment constraints require tradeoffs.

Defect Management & Release Readiness

* Lead defect triage in partnership with Product and Engineering, ensuring severity, priority, business impact, and ownership are clear.
* Track critical defects through resolution and retest and ensure unresolved quality risks are explicitly documented before release decisions.
* Define and enforce practical QA exit criteria, including expectations for critical defect closure, regression completion, and stability.
* Provide an objective quality recommendation for releases based on test evidence and known risk.
* Identify recurring defect patterns and partner with Engineering and Product on preventive actions rather than relying only on downstream testing.

Automation & Continuous Improvement

* Develop and maintain a pragmatic test automation strategy focused on high-value regression, repeatable workflows, integrations, and business-critical scenarios.
* Partner with QA Automation Engineers and Engineering to increase reliable automated coverage without creating brittle or low-value automation.
* Use modern AI-assisted tools, where appropriate, to accelerate test-case creation, test-data design, automation development, and quality analysis while preserving human review and accountability.
* Evaluate test tooling, frameworks, and processes and recommend improvements that increase efficiency, coverage, and maintainability.
* Reduce manual regression effort over time by identifying the strongest candidates for automation and incorporating automated tests into delivery pipelines where feasible.

Cross-Functional Partnership

* Work closely with Product Owners to ensure requirements and acceptance criteria are clear, testable, and aligned to expected business outcomes.
* Partner with Engineering on defect prevention, unit/integration test expectations, environment stability, observability, and root-cause analysis.
* Collaborate with Architecture and platform teams when quality issues involve integration, infrastructure, data movement, or systemic technical risk.
* Support business UAT by ensuring the product is genuinely ready for validation and by helping distinguish blocking defects from non-blocking follow-up work.
* Communicate quality risk in clear business terms so leadership can make informed release and prioritization decisions.

Metrics & Reporting

* Maintain a small, actionable set of QA metrics that reflect product quality and execution health rather than activity alone.
* Track measures such as test execution progress, escaped defects, defect severity, defect reopen rate, regression coverage, automation coverage, UAT rework, and recurring defect trends.
* Use metrics to identify systemic improvement opportunities and to show whether changes to process, automation, or requirements quality are producing measurable results.
* Provide concise status reporting that clearly states current quality, material risks, blockers, required decisions, and next actions.

**Required Qualifications**

* Significant hands-on experience in software quality assurance, including functional, integration, regression, and end-to-end testing.
* Experience leading QA execution, mentoring testers, or functioning as a senior/lead resource responsible for quality outcomes.
* Strong understanding of Agile/Scrum delivery and the role of QA throughout discovery, development, testing, UAT, and release.
* Demonstrated ability to create test strategies and translate complex business workflows into thorough, risk-based test coverage.

new_jobs.title: Strategic Market Manager, North America
new_jobs.description:
Ashland Specialty Ingredients, GP

**Strategic Regional Market Manager, North America**

Are you the kind of person that is always thinking, sketching, seeking, and adjusting? Who needs to understand how things work and then figure out how they can work better? Are you a passionate, tenacious, solver who loves to work with others who share your drive? Are you positive, constructive, and ingenious?

Are you always solving?

Then we’d like to meet you and bet you’d like to meet us.

Ashland has an exciting opportunity for a **Strategic Regional Marketing Manager** to join our Ashland Life Sciences business. This is a very visible, significant role within the Company. This position will report to the Head of Strategic Accounts and Market Development.

**The responsibilities of the position include, but are not limited to, the following:**

* Develop and execute North American strategic marketing plans aligned with regional and global business objectives.
* Develop market segmentation strategies and value propositions for target customer groups.
* Identify market trends, customer needs, competitive threats, and emerging opportunities to drive sustainable growth.
* Monitor industry trends, regulatory developments, customer dynamics, and competitive activity.
* Conduct market research and voice-of-customer initiatives to identify unmet customer needs and emerging market opportunities.
* Partner with R&D, innovation, and product management teams to support new product development and commercialization.
* Lead go-to-market planning for new product launches and strategic growth platforms.
* Collaborate closely with sales leadership and account teams to ensure alignment between strategic marketing initiatives and commercial execution.
* Generate market-facing tools, customer insights, and growth strategies that enable sales effectiveness.
* Support strategic customer engagement and executive-level business reviews.

* Actively contribute to the organizational goals by taking initiative, executing on goals and focusing on performance and safety
Improve the organization capacity and capabilities through building collaborative relationships, optimizing diverse talent and utilizing positive communications and influence with others  

**In order to be qualified for this role, you** ***must possess*** **the following:**

* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Life Sciences, Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, or a related field.
* 3-5 years of progressive experience in strategic marketing, product management, market development, or commercial strategy.
* Experience within life sciences, specialty chemicals, pharmaceutical ingredients, nutraceuticals, personal care ingredients, or related B2B industries.
* Strong experience conducting market analysis and developing growth strategies.
* Demonstrated success leading cross-functional initiatives and influencing stakeholders.
* Excellent analytical, communication, presentation, and project management skills.
* Ability to travel up to 30%.
* Demonstrate responsible and ethical behavior at all times
The ability to help the company drive greater value through understanding the business, making complex decisions and creating the new and different.  

**The following skill sets are** ***preferred*** **by the business unit** :

* MBA or advanced degree in business, marketing, or a scientific discipline.
* Experience supporting North American markets across multiple customer segments.
* Familiarity with stage-gate innovation processes and new product commercialization.
Experience working within a global matrix organization.  

In more than 100 countries, the people of Ashland LLC. (NYSE: ASH) provide the specialty chemicals, technologies and insights to help customers create new and improved products for today and sustainable solutions for tomorrow. Our chemistry is at work every day in a wide variety of markets and applications, including architectural coatings, automotive, construction, energy, personal care and pharmaceutical. Visit www.ashland.com to see the innovations we offer.
  
  
At Ashland our vision is to be a leading, global specialty chemicals company whose inspired and engaged employees add value to all we touch. In fact our people, employees, customers and vendors define who we are. They are the driving force behind everything we do.
  
  
Not only do we value our customers but we value our employees, and we work to offer them a dynamic and challenging environment. We hold ourselves to high standards at Ashland, and we value integrity and honesty.
  
  
Ashland has a history of attracting the best people and keeping them. The reasons are simple: industry competitive salary and benefits, pay-for-performance incentive plans and a diverse work environment where employees feel challenged and valued. People come to Ashland and stay. As a growing Fortune 500 specialty chemicals company, we offer opportunities for development and advancement throughout our global organization. Our values define who we are and what we care about as a company. If you are looking for a relationship with a company instead of simply a job, this may be a great fit.

Ashland is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer Minorities/Women/Veterans/Disabled/Gender Identity/Sexual Orientation.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, or protected veteran status and will not be discriminated against on the basis of disability.
